compare: 上一版v5与本次v6，按同一动作和时间比较头模比例。

ground_motion.method: Both idle boots planted flat, walk supporting legs adapted locally; original pelvis side sway preserved.

Walk.method: Support-leg IK with preserved shoulder/hip sway and at most 16mm smooth pelvis cycle

Idle.body_motion_preserved: Original hips, spine, clavicle, arm and wrist motion retained; finger curves replaced by revision5 hand adaptation.

Walk.body_motion_preserved: Original hips, spine, clavicle, arm and wrist motion retained; finger curves replaced by revision5 hand adaptation.

initial_floor_alignment.method: Actual deformed rest-sole vertices; one constant world-Z pelvis offset per action.

Walk.method: Support-leg IK with preserved shoulder/hip sway and at most 16mm smooth pelvis cycle

idle_clearance.method: Evaluated hand mesh against lower-body and side-pouch triangles; ray parity resolves open-edge normal-projection false positives.

head_replacement.neck_transition: Continuous 39-column 9-ring bridge shares the original skin-port vertices; no overlapping lower tube border
head_replacement.new_head_binding: Fitted XQ/Head-subtree weights, max4 influences, no torso/Neck influences on face
head_replacement.texture_seam: Continuous 512x128 PNG longitudinal gradient sampled from the original skin port; no angular height steps

proportion_correction.face_shape_method: Exact inverse of revision5 nonuniform XY scale; one uniform source scale, no sculpting
proportion_correction.neck_blend: Shared skin-port row fixed; smoothstep blend to corrected head cross-section at top

revision5_fit.clearance_method: Smoothed cylindrical head cross-sections; no tangential nearest-face snapping

hand_binding_and_poses.method: Anatomical flexion axes replace incompatible terminal-joint roll; distal digits use their own continuous phalanx weights
